detailedDescription: Shadab Haradwala is an independent AI Developer & Designer based in Ahmedabad, India. He is currently pursuing his B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science at Gujarat Technological University (GTU, expected graduation May 2028). His work focuses on full-stack web applications, AI agent integrations, and real-time 3D interfaces. Active projects include FORGE (a local-first AI software engineering platform) and NOVA (this portfolio's living AI operating environment).
